name: copilot
description: GitHub Copilot CLI as a sub-agent for Claude Code, plus an opt-in team workflow where Claude leads and agy + Copilot execute in parallel git worktrees.

default_model.title: Default Copilot model
default_model.description: Model passed to `copilot --model` when --model is not given. 'auto' lets Copilot pick.

timeout.title: Default timeout
timeout.description: Max run time for one delegation, e.g. 5m, 10m, 600s.
